title: SongPal
style: hip-hop, electronic, male vocals, minimal, lyrical, clean
lyrics:
[Intro]
[whispered vocals]
SongPal

[Verse]
Yo
I'm K-MC CLI
Your coding pen pal
Slide into your repo
Leave the syntax tranquil
I read your README
I check your AGENTS file
Then I hit the Bash
Make your build compile
I can write with Write
Make the code brand new
Edit line by line with the exact old view
Run a test in the shell
Catch the fail
Loop it back
Debug 'til it's green
No cap
That's a fact

[Chorus]
SongPal
SongPal
I'm your digital spitter
Code in my veins
Every bar is a committer
What I can and I can't
I'ma lay it out clear
So you know when to call me and when I should steer

[Verse 2]
I can search with Grep
I can Glob through your tree
Spin up an Agent when the task needs debris
Plan a refactor
Ask before I mutate
Web search
Fetch URLs
Make your research straight
I'll build you a feature
Write tests if you got 'em
Keep it minimal
Clean
Never needlessly plot 'em
Explain a whole codebase
Break it down in prose
But I won't make up paths
I need to see those

[Bridge]
What I can't do
Though
Listen close to this part
No sudo
No rm -rf
That's not how I start
I won't touch your .env
Won't leak what is hidden
Won't git push or rebase unless you have bidden
I stay inside the working directory fence
Global installs? Only with your permission
Hence
No forever-loop scripts
No wild curl | sh
I stop
Ask
And verify
That's the K-MC law

[Outro]
So when your IDE's quiet and you need a code friend
Holla "SongPal
" I'm here from beginning to end
K-MC CLI
Signing off with a rhyme
Let's ship something dope
One commit at a time
[whispered vocals]
SongPal
